title: Yellow Fluffy Indian Lentils Lassi
description: A quick and easy Indian dish featuring lentils, made fluffy with a yogurt based lassi, and air fried for a crispy texture, served in a Korean brass bowl.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes.
Drain the lentils and air fry them at 375 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a blender, combine the yogurt, lemon juice, honey, garam masala, turmeric, and salt.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Add the cooked lentils to the blender and blend until well combined.
Add the water to the blender and blend until the desired consistency is reached.
Heat the vegetable oil in a small pan over medium heat.
Pour the lassi mixture into a Korean brass bowl and garnish with a sprinkle of turmeric.
